blocks.text: For vehicles and combinations of vehicles on the interstate system (national system of interstate and defense highways), the table in TMC 10.75.130 shall not authorize a maximum gross weight of more than 80,000 pounds. (Code 1981 § 43-681. Code 1995 § 142-750.)
